Hotels.Name: Majorca Test Hotel 01
Hotels.Description: This bungalow complex is situated in Caleta de Fuste. In the vicinity, guests will find restaurants, shopping centres, pathways and bars. The hotel is 600 m from golden beaches and the mild, Atlantic waters of the Canary Islands. There are public transportation links just 15 minutes from the unique marina, and Fuerteventura Airport is 8 km from the hotel. This wonderful island offers attractions to suit all tastes and ensure an unforgettable holiday.
